lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Birdie!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Something really great happened today!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I wanted you to be the first to know, so I contacted you right away.
What happened?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I received a fan letter!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Let me read it to you, so you better pay attention!
For a while, there's nothing but silence.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Did you hear that, Birdie?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Brings a tear to your eye, doesn't it?
Erm... I didn't hear anything.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I thought it was a voice call.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: No probs, I'll just type it out.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hello, Laplace.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Thanks to your heroic deeds,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: our district is once again thriving.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: You helped us band together and work towards a common goal:

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: repairing all the broken windows you left behind.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: The crater you made during your grand entrance shattered the water pipes,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: so we've all been sharing whatever water we have.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Thank you for teaching us the joy of working together and sharing with our neighbors.
You call that a fan letter?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Oh, right. The large amount of fire extinguishing fluid you used to put out the fire

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: is still running down the walls of the building,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: but it allowed us to escape unscathed.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Thank you so much, Laplace.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I can't wait to see what you have in store for us in the future.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I would love to meet you sometime.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Please let me know when's a good time for you.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'd love to meet you in person to repay you for your deed.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: That's it!
This fan letter...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Woo-hoo!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: This is what being a hero is all about!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I've got to meet my number one fan!
I would suggest against that.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Why!!??
It's cooler to maintain an aura of mystery.
After all, heroes don't do meet-and-greets.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Makes sense.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'll just keep this letter close and never lose this feeling!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Quick! We must strike while the iron is hot!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Let the special training begin!
